name: Commission will engage with industry following European Citizens' Initiative on the disabling of videogames by publishers

source.license: Copyright European Union (reuse authorised, Commission Decision 2011/833/EU)

statement: The Commission press release that states its reply to the 'Stop Destroying Videogames' citizens' initiative and the steps it commits to; served by the presscorner API, whose JSON is not byte-stable, so no sha256 is pinned. Index row Y08.
